cosmology.band: not converted: each design point is per unit X of its own cosmology
cosmology.conversion: values and limits per unit X multiplied by Delta X(own Omega_m) / Delta X(line Omega_m) over the measurement's redshift range, flat cosmologies; Delta X = integral of (1+z)^2 / sqrt(Omega_m (1+z)^3 + 1 - Omega_m) dz
cosmology.lls_conversion: l(z) to l(X): Delta z / Delta X(line Omega_m) over the row's bin

cumulative.cross_check: the LLS line less the sum of pred.cddf from 10^17.2 to 10^17.5, plus the subDLA and the DLA line; ratio = the count above 10^17.5 / this sum
cumulative.label: model (LF+MF): all absorbers with N_HI >= 10^17.5
cumulative.method: sum over the bins of pred.cddf of f times the width in N_HI of the bin's part above the threshold; the bin that holds the threshold counts from it to its upper edge, f taken constant within the bin; a bin with no value (NaN) is left out

heldout_error: drawn on the model lines (LF+MF): the held-out range from pred.dndx_lower to pred.dndx_upper (pred.dndx * exp(-pred.dndx_err) and pred.dndx * exp(+pred.dndx_err), each bound computed on its own: asymmetric); pred.dndx_err is the held-out rms of ln(prediction / truth)

lls_measurements.counts: every absorber with tau_912 >= 2 (N_HI >= 10^17.5), per unit redshift as published; drawn per unit X: l(X) = l(z) Delta z / Delta X(line) over each row's redshift bin, errors times the same factor
lls_measurements.not_drawn: the other rows of the table: contained in a drawn row, or counting the same absorbers

own_marker.fumagalli20_dr16: classified as tau >~ 2; may include systems just below tau = 2 (the paper)

lls_measurements.poisson_interval_means: drawn with the larger printed error upward; the table keeps the print

measurement: DLA dN/dX of Ho, Bird and Garnett (2021), 68 per cent interval: docs/figures/data/ho21/dndx_all.txt, 18 redshift bins
